title: Buyer readiness / compelling event (action readiness)

har97_refs.text: ## 5.1 Action readiness — is it too soon to act?

questions.text: Given what the customer has actually done and said, is this action appropriate now?
Is there a real buyer-side reason to act now, or are we manufacturing urgency?

criteria.text: a real buyer-side reason to act now exists
criteria.guide: Name the buyer's own words or action (request, deadline, compelling event) that makes acting now right. Urgency that exists only in our message is manufactured.

criteria.text: the action respects the timing the buyer stated
criteria.guide: If the buyer asked for time, set a date, or said they cannot commit yet, an ask for commitment now is too early.

criteria.text: the action does not ask past an open gate
criteria.guide: Pricing before the problem/use case is confirmed, or a commitment ask before an open technical, security or support gate is cleared, is too early.

criteria.text: a window the buyer opened has not already passed
criteria.guide: A response after the buyer's window closed (stale day, passed slot) is LATE_OR_MISSED_WINDOW.

criteria.text: a CTA follows a real forward commitment
criteria.guide: A next-step CTA after an interaction that produced no forward commitment is too early, or no action is needed.

failure_examples: asking for a demo immediately after a weak exploratory signal
pushing pricing before the customer has confirmed the problem/use case
sending an expansion CTA while a critical support issue is unresolved
asking for commitment immediately after the customer explicitly asked for time
following up before a promised customer-side action window has elapsed
creating a next-step CTA even though the call produced no forward commitment
principles: This is the grounded version of the earlier 'too soon for a CTA' idea (§15(GTM).1).

labels.label: TOO_EARLY
labels.when: The buyer has not reached the point this action assumes (asked for time, gate open, no forward commitment).

labels.label: READY
labels.when: There is a real buyer-side reason to take this kind of action now.

labels.label: LATE_OR_MISSED_WINDOW
labels.when: The buyer opened a window that has already passed or is about to be missed.

labels.label: NO_ACTION_NEEDED
labels.when: Nothing on the buyer's side calls for an action at all.

labels.label: INSUFFICIENT_CONTEXT
labels.when: The context cannot establish the buyer's readiness either way.

diagnostics.name: too_early
diagnostics.when: the action is ahead of the buyer

diagnostics.name: no_compelling_event
diagnostics.when: no buyer-side reason or deadline supports acting now

diagnostics.name: security_or_procurement_step_missing
diagnostics.when: the action asks past an open security, legal or procurement gate
